threshold_note: T_roll_p75 threshold; threshold_value is latest if rolling
strategy_description: Hold SPY when the lagged unemployment signal is favorable; otherwise hold cash.
lead_description: Signal is lagged 4 month(s) before allocation.
notes: UNRATE is a lagging labor-market indicator; strategy results should be read as defensive regime context, not a clean leading forecast. Winner (chg_6m) is selected by in-sample Sharpe on the common IS window (1999-12-31 to 2016-12-31) and evaluated on the held-out OOS window (from 2017-01); still a search-selected rule.

selection.objective_formula: in-sample (common window [common_is_start, OOS start 2017-01)) monthly mean/std*sqrt(12); winner evaluated on OOS window

is_window.rule: common_is_start = latest first-valid-return date across all grid candidates; IS metrics for every candidate computed on [common_is_start, oos_start)

selection.rationale: Winner is the IS-valid row with the highest IN-SAMPLE Sharpe (common IS window) over the published grid; OOS metrics are reported for that row only (no OOS look-ahead in selection).

legacy_oos_selected_row.note: Pre-GH#251 OOS-argmax selection, comparison only; see legacy_oos_selection_20261016.csv

sensitivity_own_is_start_row.note: IS argmax without common-start alignment; sensitivity only
